name: telemath_stats_1xA100_Sep2026
_note: Per-cluster TRAINING statistics for the nine-model TeleMath pool, measured on 1 x A100 at concurrency 32 under vLLM 0.19.0, k = 4 clusters over the 299-question train split. This is the only pool in the package whose cost ordering CHANGES between clusters, 5 of 36 model pairs under TPOT and 3 of 36 under E2EL, which is the precondition a per-cluster cost rule needs to change a routing at all; on the AIME and TeleQnA pools both rules return the same routing. Fit it with `cre fit --stats configs/telemath_stats_1xA100_Sep2026.json --budget 25 --cost-metric tpot` or `--cost-metric e2el --budget 25000`, and add `--cost-conditioning cluster` to price cost per (model, cluster) instead of per model.
